protocol.selection: Checkpoint fixed before evaluation. No training, selection, threshold fitting or pool reranking.
protocol.test_status: Repeated evaluation of an already inspected held-out split; not new independent validation.
protocol.external_scope: Generalization in the supervised predictor only; encoder pretraining overlap cannot be ruled out.
protocol.unlabeled_interpretation: MATH, HumanEval, official GSM8K test and authored prompts lack fixed-pool outcome labels. Predictions alone cannot establish difficulty accuracy.
